name: Algebraic-State Obfuscation
description: I replaced the standard Independent Set equation (edges between partitions equals sum of degrees of the chosen partition) with a mathematically equivalent but highly obscure identity focused entirely on the complement partition (edges within the complement equals sum of degrees of the complement minus total edges). This breaks pattern-matching, forcing the model to either perform non-trivial algebraic reduction or rely on a generic branch-and-bound that is likely to miss the monotonicity required for pruning.
